items.title: What Is Digital Realty Trust (DLR) Signaling With Its Global AI Infrastructure Push?
items.summary: Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR) has taken a significant equity stake in Australian data centre operator NextDC alongside Goodman Group. The company is extending its Innovation Lab network into Latin America, with the first facility focused on AI infrastructure use cases. Management also plans new Innovation Lab locations in Singapore and Johannesburg to widen access to AI-ready data centre environments. items.title: 3 Data Center REIT Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching After AI Policy Fears
items.summary: AI related spending is now big enough to move U.S. GDP and jobs data, yet talk of possible data center restrictions has knocked confidence and created pockets of mispricing. That mix of strong economic numbers and headline risk is where opportunity often hides. This article walks through three U.S. data center and colocation REIT stocks that look especially exposed to the latest news shock, and explains why their stories matter for your portfolio. items.title: BMO Highlights Data Center Stocks as Development Risks Rise
items.summary: Investing.com -- BMO Capital Markets has identified the best-positioned data center stocks as recent election results in key states raise the risk of development delays and potential moratoriums. According to analysts Ari Klein and John P. Kim, uncertainty around future development has increased, though sub-1% vacancy rates and strong AI demand should support pricing for existing operators.

items.title: Digital Realty Just Paid a 45% Premium for a Stake in a Rival Data Center Stock
items.summary: Two days after a guidance cut sent NEXTDC reeling, a trust co-owned by Digital Realty came knocking with an offer the target calls a raid. The buyers say they have no takeover plans, but they kept the door open.
